:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-mle}
#### Maximum likelihood estimate of the exponential mean

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle,
use the [score](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-score) from @exr-prac-exp-mle-score to solve the [score equation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-score-equation)
$$
\score(\pmean; \vx) = 0
$$
to show that $\hat\pmean_{ML} = \bar{x}$.

:::
